data.title: 玛奇玛 · 雨幕高阶的无声驯服
data.action: 优雅坐在深灰皮质沙发中央，双腿优雅交叠，修长双手十指相扣搭在膝上，圈圈眼眸深不可测，微笑着温声吐露让人无法抗拒的旨意。
data.location: 极简现代顶层公寓，巨大的玻璃幕墙外暴雨倾盆撞击玻璃
data.lighting: 阴郁的冷灰雨天漫射光，唯有头顶暗藏的暖白筒灯柔和打在发丝与双肩上
data.mood: 压倒性的掌控欲与令人窒息的知性魅力，冷静而致命
data.description: 极简现代顶层公寓，巨大的玻璃幕墙外暴雨倾盆撞击玻璃。优雅坐在深灰皮质沙发中央，双腿优雅交叠，修长双手十指相扣搭在膝上，圈圈眼眸深不可测，微笑着温声吐露让人无法抗拒的旨意。 她微微抬眸轻语——“乖孩子……把头靠在我的膝盖上。今晚所有的工作都结束了，现在只需要服从我。”
data.promptProse: Seated with unhurried command in the center of a dark grey leather sofa inside a minimalist high-rise penthouse during a torrential night storm, Makima wears a sheer black floral lace corset babydoll and thin velvet choker. Crossing her bare legs neatly with her fingers interlaced across her knee, she fixes the viewer with a serene, hypnotic smile as rain lashes the floor-to-ceiling glass wall behind her under soft overhead recessed light.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the dark leather penthouse sofa with crossed bare legs and clasped hands in her sheer black floral lace corset babydoll and velvet choker, Makima watches the viewer with a calm, hypnotic smile. Heavy rain streams down the towering glass wall behind her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a razor-tailored pure-black sheer floral lace corset babydoll with contoured underwire cups and a slender black velvet choker, revealing her pale shoulders and crossed bare legs.
